title: Vendor Insurance Certificate Gap
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:vendor vendor_type=* insurance_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(insurance_state!="received",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by vendor_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending insurance certificates backlog by vendor type for vendor compliance.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside vendor compliance.
implementation: Mark each `event:vendor` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `vendor_type`.
visualization: Table of vendor type with pending insurance certificates counts.
grandmaExplanation: It frames where unfinished insurance certificates are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in vendor compliance.
